g.text: Figure 2. The three-stage conversion pipeline transforms MDL-based USD scenes into UsdPreviewSurface while maintaining compositional integrity. Stage 1
recursively builds a dependency graph and creates sibling files with preserved arcs. Stage 2 converts MDL materials to minimal four-channel UsdPreviewSurface networks,
discarding unsupported features. Stage 3 rewrites all internal asset paths to point to the new converted variants, resulting in a fully self-consistent scene.
